name: live-sky
title: Live Sky
description: The sky over a place right now, seen looking up between buildings: real weather from Open-Meteo (or your fetcher) drawn with WebGL, the sun and moon where they stand, clouds from the cloud cover, and rain that falls toward the viewer with depth, slants with the wind and runs down a pane of glass. Drizzle, rain and downpour, snow and fog look different; reduced motion shows stills with a slow crossfade. A place search, a geolocation button, and setLocation, geolocate and refresh for agents.

files.content:
import type { SunState, WeatherCondition } from "@/components/ui/live-sky-conditions"

/** The words of a summary, already formatted, for `labels.summary` to put in the page's order. */
type SkySummaryParts = { condition: string; temperature: string; sun: string; place: string }

type LiveSkyLabels = {
  /** Names the place search's input. */
  search: string
  searchPlaceholder: string
  searching: string
  searchFailed: string
  /** The empty list's text, given the query. */
  noPlaces: (query: string) => string
  /** The result count screen readers hear once typing pauses. */
  places: (count: number) => string
  geolocate: string
  locating: string
  /** Why the location button is off once the person blocked location access. */
  locationDenied: string
  locationFailed: string
  /** The place name for a geolocated sky. */
  here: string
  refresh: string
  loading: string
  failed: string
  retry: string
  /** Shown before the sky has a place. */
  noPlace: string
  /** A badge on simulated weather. */
  simulated: string
  temperature: string
  precipitation: string
  wind: string
  conditions: Record<WeatherCondition, string>
  sun: Record<SunState, string>
  /** The sentence screen readers and agents read for the sky: "Moderate rain, 12 °C, sun behind clouds". */
  summary: (parts: SkySummaryParts) => string
}

const liveSkyLabels: LiveSkyLabels = {
  search: "Search for a place",
  searchPlaceholder: "Search a city",
  searching: "Searching…",
  searchFailed: "The place search failed.",
  noPlaces: (query) => `No place matches “${query}”.`,
  places: (count) => (count === 1 ? "1 place" : `${String(count)} places`),
  geolocate: "Use my location",
  locating: "Finding you…",
  locationDenied: "Location access is blocked in this browser.",
  locationFailed: "Your location couldn't be found.",
  here: "Your location",
  refresh: "Refresh the weather",
  loading: "Loading the weather…",
  failed: "The weather couldn't be loaded.",
  retry: "Try again",
  noPlace: "Choose a place, or use your location, to see its sky.",
  simulated: "Simulated",
  temperature: "Temperature",
  precipitation: "Precipitation",
  wind: "Wind",
  conditions: {
    clear: "Clear sky",
    mainlyClear: "Mainly clear",
    partlyCloudy: "Partly cloudy",
    overcast: "Overcast",
    fog: "Fog",
    rimeFog: "Freezing fog",
    lightDrizzle: "Light drizzle",
    drizzle: "Drizzle",
    denseDrizzle: "Dense drizzle",
    freezingDrizzle: "Freezing drizzle",
    lightRain: "Light rain",
    rain: "Moderate rain",
    heavyRain: "Heavy rain",
    freezingRain: "Freezing rain",
    lightSnow: "Light snow",
    snow: "Moderate snow",
    heavySnow: "Heavy snow",
    snowGrains: "Snow grains",
    lightShowers: "Light showers",
    showers: "Rain showers",
    violentShowers: "Violent showers",
    snowShowers: "Snow showers",
    thunderstorm: "Thunderstorm",
    thunderstormHail: "Thunderstorm with hail",
    unknown: "Unknown weather",
  },
  sun: {
    up: "sun out",
    behindClouds: "sun behind clouds",
    low: "sun low on the horizon",
    down: "after dark",
  },
  summary: ({ condition, temperature, sun }) => `${condition}, ${temperature}, ${sun}`,
}

export { liveSkyLabels }
export type { LiveSkyLabels, SkySummaryParts }

import {
  daylightAt,
  moonPhase,
  moonPosition,
  radiansPerDegree,
  sunPosition,
  type Daylight,
} from "@/components/ui/live-sky-astronomy"
import type { SkyLocation, SkyWeather } from "@/components/ui/live-sky-weather"

/** What WMO weather codes mean, one key per description a person reads. */
type WeatherCondition =
  | "clear"
  | "mainlyClear"
  | "partlyCloudy"
  | "overcast"
  | "fog"
  | "rimeFog"
  | "lightDrizzle"
  | "drizzle"
  | "denseDrizzle"
  | "freezingDrizzle"
  | "lightRain"
  | "rain"
  | "heavyRain"
  | "freezingRain"
  | "lightSnow"
  | "snow"
  | "heavySnow"
  | "snowGrains"
  | "lightShowers"
  | "showers"
  | "violentShowers"
  | "snowShowers"
  | "thunderstorm"
  | "thunderstormHail"
  | "unknown"

const conditionsByCode: Record<number, WeatherCondition> = {
  0: "clear",
  1: "mainlyClear",
  2: "partlyCloudy",
  3: "overcast",
  45: "fog",
  48: "rimeFog",
  51: "lightDrizzle",
  53: "drizzle",
  55: "denseDrizzle",
  56: "freezingDrizzle",
  57: "freezingDrizzle",
  61: "lightRain",
  63: "rain",
  65: "heavyRain",
  66: "freezingRain",
  67: "freezingRain",
  71: "lightSnow",
  73: "snow",
  75: "heavySnow",
  77: "snowGrains",
  80: "lightShowers",
  81: "showers",
  82: "violentShowers",
  85: "snowShowers",
  86: "snowShowers",
  95: "thunderstorm",
  96: "thunderstormHail",
  99: "thunderstormHail",
}

const conditionOf = (weatherCode: number): WeatherCondition => conditionsByCode[weatherCode] ?? "unknown"

/** How rain looks: drizzle hangs as fine mist, rain falls in streaks, a downpour in sheets. */
type RainKind = "none" | "drizzle" | "rain" | "downpour"

/** Where the sun is for the summary: up in a clear sky, behind clouds, setting or rising, or down. */
type SunState = "up" | "behindClouds" | "low" | "down"

const drizzleCodes = new Set([51, 53, 55, 56, 57])
const downpourCodes = new Set([65, 67, 82, 96, 99])
const snowCodes = new Set([71, 73, 75, 77, 85, 86])
const fogCodes = new Set([45, 48])
const thunderCodes = new Set([95, 96, 99])

const downpourMmPerHour = 7.6
const rainMmPerHour = 0.5
const traceMmPerHour = 0.05
const defaultDrizzleMmPerHour = 0.25

function rainKindOf(weather: SkyWeather, falling: number): RainKind {
  if (falling < traceMmPerHour && !drizzleCodes.has(weather.weatherCode)) return "none"
  if (drizzleCodes.has(weather.weatherCode) || falling < rainMmPerHour) return "drizzle"
  if (downpourCodes.has(weather.weatherCode) || falling >= downpourMmPerHour) return "downpour"
  return "rain"
}

/** Everything the scene draws, derived from the weather, the place and the time. */
type SkyConditions = {
  condition: WeatherCondition
  daylight: Daylight
  sun: { altitude: number; azimuth: number }
  moon: { altitude: number; azimuth: number; fraction: number; waxing: boolean }
  sunState: SunState
  /** Liquid rain in mm/h, drizzle included. */
  rainRate: number
  rainKind: RainKind
  /** Snow in cm/h. */
  snowRate: number
  /** Cloud cover from 0 to 1. */
  cover: number
  /** How dark the cloud base is, from 0 (fair-weather white) to 1 (storm grey). */
  gloom: number
  /** Fog from 0 (clear air) to 1 (under 200 m visibility). */
  fog: number
  /** The wind in m/s toward east and north. */
  wind: { east: number; north: number }
  /** How wet the façades look, from 0 to 1. */
  wetness: number
  thunder: boolean
  temperature: number
}

const kmPerHourToMetresPerSecond = 1 / 3.6
const clearAirVisibilityM = 20_000
const thickFogVisibilityM = 200
const clamp01 = (value: number) => Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value))

function fogOf(weather: SkyWeather) {
  const fromVisibility = clamp01(
    Math.log(clearAirVisibilityM / Math.max(weather.visibility, 1)) /
      Math.log(clearAirVisibilityM / thickFogVisibilityM),
  )
  return fogCodes.has(weather.weatherCode) ? Math.max(0.65, fromVisibility) : fromVisibility
}

function sunStateOf(sunAltitudeDegrees: number, cover: number, falling: boolean): SunState {
  if (sunAltitudeDegrees < -0.8) return "down"
  if (cover > 0.7 || falling) return "behindClouds"
  if (sunAltitudeDegrees < 8) return "low"
  return "up"
}

function skyConditions(weather: SkyWeather, location: SkyLocation, at: Date): SkyConditions {
  const sun = sunPosition(at, location.latitude, location.longitude)
  const moonAt = moonPosition(at, location.latitude, location.longitude)
  const phase = moonPhase(at)
  const sunDegrees = sun.altitude / radiansPerDegree
  const snowing = snowCodes.has(weather.weatherCode) || weather.snowfall > 0.05
  const liquid = snowing
    ? weather.rain + weather.showers
    : Math.max(weather.precipitation, weather.rain + weather.showers)
  const kind = rainKindOf(weather, liquid)
  const rainRate = kind === "drizzle" ? Math.max(liquid, defaultDrizzleMmPerHour) : liquid
  const snowRate = snowing ? Math.max(weather.snowfall, 0.2) : 0
  const falling = kind !== "none" || snowRate > 0
  const cover = clamp01(Math.max(weather.cloudCover / 100, falling ? 0.85 : 0))
  const towardRadians = (weather.windDirection + 180) * radiansPerDegree
  const windSpeed = weather.windSpeed * kmPerHourToMetresPerSecond
  return {
    condition: conditionOf(weather.weatherCode),
    daylight: daylightAt(sunDegrees),
    sun,
    moon: { ...moonAt, fraction: phase.fraction, waxing: phase.waxing },
    sunState: sunStateOf(sunDegrees, cover, falling),
    rainRate,
    rainKind: kind,
    snowRate,
    cover,
    gloom: clamp01(
      (falling ? 0.35 : 0) + Math.min(rainRate, 12) / 16 + (thunderCodes.has(weather.weatherCode) ? 0.3 : 0),
    ),
    fog: fogOf(weather),
    wind: { east: Math.sin(towardRadians) * windSpeed, north: Math.cos(towardRadians) * windSpeed },
    wetness: clamp01(rainRate > 0 ? 0.45 + rainRate / 6 : 0),
    thunder: thunderCodes.has(weather.weatherCode),
    temperature: weather.temperature,
  }
}

export { conditionOf, skyConditions }
export type { RainKind, SkyConditions, SunState, WeatherCondition }

import { keysOf, recordOf } from "@/lib/narrow"

/** A colour as linear-ish 0 to 1 channels, the way the shaders and the sky function mix them. */
type Rgb = readonly [number, number, number]

const skyPaletteDefaults = {
  "night-zenith": "#03050c",
  "night-horizon": "#121a30",
  "blue-zenith": "#101d47",
  "blue-horizon": "#3f5288",
  "dawn-zenith": "#24356c",
  "dawn-horizon": "#d9845c",
  "dawn-glow": "#ff8f4a",
  "golden-zenith": "#4c77b9",
  "golden-horizon": "#f0c07c",
  "golden-glow": "#ffc25e",
  "day-zenith": "#2a68cc",
  "day-horizon": "#a6cbf0",
  "day-glow": "#fff4dc",
  "cloud-light": "#f3f4f6",
  "cloud-dark": "#474d5a",
  "city-glow": "#6a5650",
  fog: "#b4bbc4",
  sun: "#fff2d2",
  moon: "#efece2",
  "window-warm": "#ffc173",
  "window-cool": "#cfe0ff",
  "street-light": "#ffb35c",
  facade: "#d8d0c2",
  "facade-stone": "#b3a089",
  "facade-concrete": "#8d9399",
  "facade-gallery": "#ecebe6",
  rain: "#cbd8e8",
  snow: "#ffffff",
} as const

type SkyPaletteKey = keyof typeof skyPaletteDefaults
type SkyPalette = Record<SkyPaletteKey, Rgb>

const hexColour = /^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/i

function parseHex(value: string): Rgb | null {
  const match = hexColour.exec(value.trim())
  if (!match) return null
  const packed = Number.parseInt(match[1]!, 16)
  return [((packed >> 16) & 255) / 255, ((packed >> 8) & 255) / 255, (packed & 255) / 255]
}

const paletteKeys = keysOf(skyPaletteDefaults)

const defaultColour = (key: SkyPaletteKey) => parseHex(skyPaletteDefaults[key]) ?? [0, 0, 0]

/** The scene's colours from the `--live-sky-*` hex custom properties on an element, each falling back to its default. */
function readPalette(element: Element | null): SkyPalette {
  const style = element ? getComputedStyle(element) : null
  return recordOf(
    paletteKeys,
    (key) => parseHex(style?.getPropertyValue(`--live-sky-${key}`) ?? "") ?? defaultColour(key),
  )
}

const mix = (a: Rgb, b: Rgb, t: number): Rgb => [
  a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t,
  a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t,
  a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t,
]
const scale = (colour: Rgb, by: number): Rgb => [colour[0] * by, colour[1] * by, colour[2] * by]
const add = (a: Rgb, b: Rgb): Rgb => [a[0] + b[0], a[1] + b[1], a[2] + b[2]]
const luminance = (colour: Rgb) => 0.2126 * colour[0] + 0.7152 * colour[1] + 0.0722 * colour[2]

const channel = (value: number) => Math.round(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, value)) * 255)
const cssColour = (colour: Rgb, alpha = 1) =>
  `rgb(${String(channel(colour[0]))} ${String(channel(colour[1]))} ${String(channel(colour[2]))} / ${String(alpha)})`

export { add, cssColour, luminance, mix, parseHex, readPalette, scale, skyPaletteDefaults }
export type { Rgb, SkyPalette, SkyPaletteKey }

docs: `<LiveSky label location onLocationChange fetchWeather searchPlaces onWeather refreshMs simulate glass locale labels>`. `location` is `{ latitude, longitude, name? }` or `"geolocate"` (the default), which offers a button that asks the browser where the person is (and locates on its own when access was already granted). The search is UI SDK's Combobox over `searchPlaces` (Open-Meteo's geocoder by default, `false` hides it), debounced. Coordinates are rounded to 2 decimals before any request and nothing is stored. The default fetchers use Open-Meteo's free API, which is for non-commercial use: for commercial use, `createOpenMeteo({ forecastUrl, geocodingUrl, apiKey })` points them at the customer hosts with your key, or pass your own `fetchWeather`. The weather is fetched while the sky is on screen and the page visible, again every `refreshMs` (10 minutes); `onWeather` gets each answer. The scene is aria-hidden: a readout shows the place, temperature and the WMO description (`labels.conditions`), and a summary sentence (`labels.summary`, "Moderate rain, 12 °C, sun behind clouds") describes the sky and is what agents read as its value. Agents call `setLocation(name | { latitude, longitude } | latitude, longitude)`, `geolocate` (fails with why when access is denied) and `refresh`; with `simulate={{ weather, time, location }}` nothing is fetched and the actions fail with why. WebGL draws it, at a lower resolution and frame rate on software GL; a 2D canvas where WebGL is missing; nothing runs while it's hidden. The palette is the item's `css`: `--live-sky-*` hex colours on `[data-slot="live-sky"]`.
